title: Initiative Compass: SLI Forecast Scenarios and Runway Risk Tags
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: Build an Initiative-level planning artifact and Console dashboard that forecasts SLI trajectories under multiple error-budget consumption scenarios, tags initiatives with runway risk, and attributes burn to owning teams so PMs and Eng leads can make tradeoffs during roadmap planning.
goals: Provide a 90/10 SLI forecast for the next 12 weeks per initiative
Surface which initiatives will exhaust error budget within the upcoming cycle (risk tags: low/medium/high)
Enable attribution of SLI burn to initiative owners and upstream dependencies
Expose a 'what-if' scenario UI to simulate mitigations (rate limit changes, canary pause, extra capacity) and show effect on runway
success_metrics: >90% of active reliability initiatives have an assigned runway risk tag each cycle
Reduce surprise production rollbacks due to SLO breaches by 35% in the next quarter
Decision latency: median time from risk detection to mitigation plan <= 2 business days
PM satisfaction score for initiative visibility > 4/5 in post-launch survey
scope_in: Per-initiative SLI forecasting for host-facing latency and availability SLIs (p50/p95/p99 latencies and availability over 1m/5m windows), initiative-level burn attribution (tokenized events and API error categories), and Console dashboard + exportable CSV.
scope_out: Auto-remediation or runtime controls (autoscaling policies, circuit breakers) — those remain engineering work items. Long-term forecasting beyond 12 weeks and per-customer SLI projection are out of scope for this ticket.
proposal_summary: Create a lightweight planner that ingests existing SLI time-series and initiative tagging from the Initiative Registry. Run three forecast models (linear trend, seasonally adjusted, and conservative shock scenario). Compute runway in days until error budget exhaustion per model. Surface the most conservative runway and a risk tag (green/amber/red). Add drilldowns to see attributable traffic, failure modes, and owning teams. Add a scenario panel to shift parameters (e.g., reduce QPS by 10%, apply canary pause) and re-run forecasts client-side for fast exploration.
dashboard_requirements: Top-level table of active initiatives with current SLI value, 3 forecast runways, risk tag, and primary owning team
Initiative detail page with time-series SLI, attribution waterfall (by error class and route), and links to related ENG/INC tickets
Scenario simulator panel that allows changing up to 3 levers and shows delta to runway in days
Export button (CSV) and API endpoint for programmatic polling
Role-based visibility: org-admins and initiative owners see sensitive attribution; others see aggregated risk
rollout_plan: Week 1: data exploration and sample exports from observability; validate initiative->service mapping (PM + Eng workshop)
Week 2: implement forecast prototype (linear + conservative) and baseline integration with Initiative Registry
Week 3: build Console dashboard UI and scenario simulator (alpha behind feature flag)
Week 4: cross-functional review with Reliability, SRE, and Growth; iterate on attribution and UX
Week 5: pilot with 3 initiatives (two infra-facing, one customer-facing); collect feedback
Week 6: finalize acceptance criteria, expand to full rollout and add API export
acceptance_criteria: Forecast runs over production SLI data and completes for 80% of initiatives in < 30s
Risk tag aligns with SRE review for pilot initiatives (>=75% agreement)
Scenario simulator accurately recomputes runway and matches bench-marked manual calculations
Dashboard access follows RBAC spec and CSV export contains initiative key, forecast type, and runway days
risks: Data quality: incomplete initiative->service mapping will produce misleading attribution
Forecast assumptions: conservative model may over-flag risks and cause unnecessary rollbacks
Performance: naive forecasting over 1000 initiatives could be slow without sampling or precomputation
Privacy: attribution data may expose customer identifiers if not redacted
updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff workshop with SRE (Rohit Patel), Console (Ava Chen), and Observability (Lena Kim). Validated that Initiative Registry has 78% coverage for active initiatives.
2026-02-25: Data export prototype created; discovered inconsistent tag naming for 'customer-latency' vs 'latency.customer' — decided to canonicalize tags in Initiative Registry (follow-up ENG-22188).
2026-03-02: Forecast prototype (linear + shock) implemented; early results indicate 12 initiatives flagged as high risk under conservative model.
2026-03-08: UX sketch reviewed; SRE requested attribution waterfall include 'upstream dependency' bucket — added to scope.
2026-03-12: Pilot plan approved. Selected pilot initiatives: PM-46807 (streaming runtime), PM-5821 (autoscaling policies), PM-314159 (rolling SLI anchor).
2026-03-15: Alpha behind flag deployed to staging. Initial performance: mean forecast latency 18s for 150 initiatives; plan to add caching and incremental precompute next sprint.
decisions: Use Initiative Registry as single source of truth for initiative ownership mapping (decision 2026-02-21)
Implement three forecast modes: optimistic (linear trend), baseline (seasonally adjusted), conservative (shock scenario) and surface conservative as default (decision 2026-02-24)
Scenario simulator will be client-side for fast iterations but will persist parameter presets server-side for reproducibility (decision 2026-03-05)
